theorem_statement: (h : ∃ n : Nat, n = 3) : ∃ m : Nat, m = 3
state_before:
h : ∃ n : Nat, n = 3
⊢ ∃ m : Nat, m = 3
tactic: cases h with | intro n hn => exact ⟨n, hn⟩
